title: Account bake-off framework and initial economic hypothesis for enterprise asks
creator: Maya Chen
description: Background: Sales and CS are regularly bringing forward multi-account enterprise asks that blur together feature requests, integration asks, and contract-specific tweaks. Current intake bundles these into long lists which are hard to prioritize quickly for PM + Eng gating. Goal: create a repeatable, lightweight 'account bake-off' framework that aggregates parallel enterprise asks, surfaces economic levers, and yields a rapid go/no-go decision and scoping envelope within 5 business days.
proposal: Deliver a three-step intake artifact suite: (1) aggregation canvas that groups asks by technical surface, customer archetype, and expected urgency; (2) a canonical econ hypothesis template that estimates incremental ARR impact, effort band, and success metrics; (3) a decision rubric for PMs with recommended routing (build short-sprint, research spike, passthrough to solutions engineering, decline). The framework will be implemented as a template (Confluence + shared spreadsheet) and a short playbook for SDR/CS handoff.
tradeoffs_and_risks:
- Low-touch template reduces friction but may oversimplify complex infra requests.
- Relying on sales-provided ARR estimates can bias prioritization; mitigation: require at least two data points (customer-stated budget + internal SMR).
- Introducing a new rubric increases process overhead for CS; mitigation: provide one-click summary output and train AM leads in a 30-minute workshop.
acceptance_criteria: Template exists in Confluence with fields: account archetype, technical surface, ask summary, estimated ARR uplift, effort band, suggested route
Three pilot bundles processed (NDA customers anonymized) with PM decision recorded within 5 business days
Feedback from CS and two AE leads indicates template reduces triage time by >=30% vs current baseline
One small feature from a pilot bundle accepted into the roadmap with an initial engineering spike (estimate <= 8 points)
initial_scoping_estimate: Scope: PM lead (0.2 wk), Solutions Eng support (0.5 wk), 3x AE/CS interviews (2 days), templating + docs (1 wk). Total: ~2.5 person-weeks across teams. Technical spike if accepted: 1 sprint (5-8 points).
